721141601.text: Hmm, those two seem to be arguing about something... Things look quite tense...

721141602.text: Paimon thinks they mentioned something about the Mikage Furnace.

721141603.text: Maybe something's happened to this island! Let's go ask those two over there.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask the two about the situation

721140901.text: Is there something I can help you with?

721140902.text: What's all this "Mikage Furnace" and "Tatarigami" talk?

721140903.text: It's just a small problem. We need a little time to sort out...

721140904.text: You're an adventurer, aren't you? This place isn't suitable for you or your ilk. Get out of here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ask the two about the situation

721141001.text: *sigh* How did it come to this...

721141002.text: What this "Mikage Furnace" that you guys were talking about earlier?

721141003.text: You're an outlander, aren't you? You've got some terrible luck to have traveled to Inazuma at this time...

721141004.text: That island is called Tatarasuna. It's a smelting plant for Jade Steel, which is used to forge weaponry.

721141005.text: Are you aware of the legends of Inazuman swords?

721141006.text: The Jade Steel manufactured here is the reason that Inazuman swords are as sharp and durable as they are.

721141008.text: No need to worry, this can hardly be called confidential military intelligence.

721141011.text: After all, the Tenryou Commission feels that having the ability to forge powerful weapons is something they should flaunt.

721141012.text: A few years ago, for the purpose of expanding production capacity, they hired a team of consultants from Fontaine. They built the Mikage Furnace, a machine that can fully harvest the powers of the Tatarigami.

721141013.text: We've warned them countless times not to let their guard down when it comes to the Tatarigami, but they decided to go ahead with the project anyway.

721141014.text: After the Mikage Furnace started production, most of the consultant team returned to Fontaine. Only Xavier, who we just mentioned, stayed behind in Inazuma.

721141015.text: But during one of the previous battles, something went wrong with the furnace. The part that stored the corrupt Tatarigami energy became extremely unstable...

721141016.text: Work was halted in Tatarasuna and everyone was evacuated shortly after.

721141017.text: Xavier took emergency action, and he seems to have set up a containment dome around the Mikage Furnace.

721141018.text: It's only a temporary solution, though. He's probably still on the island now, trying to figure out a way to solve the problem for good.

721141019.text: Meanwhile, the Shogunate is only concerned about restarting production as soon as possible. I hear that they're even considering calling the consultants from Fontaine back again.

721141020.text: But I don't think they'd be willing to come under the current conditions in Inazuma...

721141021.text: And it just has to be that Hanbei guy in charge of this whole thing, doesn't it...

721141023.text: A... manager, you could say. Always going on about procedures, articles, and applications...

721141024.text: His first reaction is never to find the solution to the problem. Instead, it's about what forms should be filled out, and which powerful individual needs to be informed about the incident beforehand.

721141025.text: He's probably in the city right now preparing to submit whatever forms he can find.

721141026.text: I really don't know if he's actually aware of the severity of the situation...

721141027.text: *sigh* I just hope that Xavier or our craftsmen can find some way to solve the problem.

721141028.text: If something were to go wrong with the Tatarigami inside the Mikage Furnace...

721141029.text: Well, if that happens, you should probably leave the island.

721141010.text: Eh, it's not that big of a secret.

721141104.text: That's true... But didn't she mention that someone named Xavier is trying to find a solution?

721141105.text: Why don't we go and take a look? It'd put our minds at ease if we could help take care of this, wouldn't it?

721140306.text: #That's right! Xavier's the name and the name's mine! But is it fate fair or foul that we should meet at this time and place? Pray tell, fine {F#lass}{M#lad}, who are you?

721140308.text: Adventurer? Ah, a grand adventurer, en route to the stars, the abyss, and beyond, arrives here on the island of conflict and Tatarigami!

721140312.text: On the way here, did you happen to see a protective cover that looks like... a bubble?

721140314.text: Oh... Okay then. No, that makes sense, the containment dome's not usually visible — if you want to view it from a distance, you have to employ a specific observation technique...

721140310.text: To help out, you say? I say, from the looks of your attire, we two are fellow Inazumaphiles on a pilgrimage of passion! A rare pleasure, my friend.

721140311.text: I must say, I am touched by your kind intentions. But I must also apologize for being frank in saying that I don't believe there is any help you can offer...

721140701.text: Let me take a look... Good, good. it hasn't suffered too much damage.

721140702.text: If all the other emergency systems are working normally, most of the energy circuits inside the device should have been cut off already. That I would consider great fortune, even amidst our many miseries.

721140703.text: Hmmm... I have a few more preparations to make, and I also need to give the problems we face here at the Mikage Furnace some thought...

721140704.text: Come find me after a while. We still have a lot of work to do here.

721140801.text: You're back. My, my, that was loud — my ear drums are still ringing.

721140802.text: After hearing the cannons, the Fatui will most certainly suspect that the Shogunate has become aware of their activities.

721140803.text: Still, something seems off here... why hasn't Tatarigami energy begun to leak out after the containment dome was destroyed?

721140804.text: Could it be that some of the Mikage Furnace's systems are still operational and have already purified some of the energy?

721140805.text: Or perhaps the Fatui are collecting that energy...

721140806.text: Whatever the case may be, please take this opportunity to go and find out...

721140401.text: Phew... The situation looks stable, at least...

721140402.text: The situation with the Mikage Furnace?

721140403.text: Yes indeed. From my observations, the internal build-up of Tatarigami energy doesn't seem too high.

721140404.text: The reason I initially activated the dome was to stop people from going inside. Mostly because of the legal liability it puts on us...

721140405.text: Basically, if too much energy accumulates inside, then this dome is completely usel—

721140406.text: Ahem! Heh... The main thing here is that everything's looking good right now, so it's happy days.

721140407.text: No need to pore over mundane details at this point. So, how is the dome looking?

721140408.text: It's got three rifts in it, and a whole load of Fatui.

721140409.text: Rifts... Wait a moment, F—Fatui? What are those sly Snezhnayans doing all the way out here?

721140411.text: You've got that right. But if the current issues with the Mikage Furnace are the Fatui's doing, then that complicates things...

721140414.text: Goodness gracious. How can this be happening!

721140415.text: I'm just a humble engineer. I only wanted to come here to do a little research, do some filming, get a taste of Inazuma's delightful culture, et cetera...

721140416.text: How did I go from that to being caught up in this whole mess!?

721140417.text: It began as a simple technical issue. Then that soldier turned up and all of a sudden it's somehow a process issue!

721140418.text: Then, somewhere during said process, it transforms again into an Inazuman domestic affair that outlanders are strictly prohibited from interfering in.

721140419.text: And now the Fatui are here. If it goes on like this, the nature of this problem is going to change quite radically indeed!

721140413.text: You really think so? If they're the cause of the issues, that really complicates things...

subQuests.subQuestName: Activate the Kamuijima Cannons and destroy the rifts
Activate the Kamuijima Cannons and destroy the rifts

721141201.text: The Fatui... What are they doing here...

721141203.text: Well, I came to Inazuma with the consultant team. In truth, I'm just your everyday engineer.

721141204.text: To be honest, my real reason for being here was to shoot a "dokumentari film" on-site at the Mikage Furnace for the purpose of promoting our nation's technologies.

721141205.text: But seeing the furnace's current state, I think it's best if I didn't shoot that film...

721141207.text: #Ah, my fine {F#lass}{M#lad}, that's a splendiferous question!

721141208.text: Indeed, I often ask myself how I might describe the charm of my country to others, even with my limited knowledge and vocabulary.

721141209.text: Now, what should I speak of first?

721141210.text: For instance, I could tell you of the majestic waterfall that made a deep impression on my soul as I worked in my study in Petrichor.

721141211.text: Or perhaps I could sing the praises of the countless gorgeous maidens in the Court of Fontaine, ethereal as the clouds themselves...

721141212.text: Or the mesmerizing lake that held the reflections of the stars and the moon, such that walking along its banks was like treading amid the celestial skies...

721141213.text: You really do love Fontaine, don't you...

721141214.text: Of course! And I shall tell you more about its wonders once I've found a satisfactory answer to that question of mine.

721141216.text: Oh, that? It's something that I discovered when I was researching Kameras.

721141217.text: I made some improvements to the Kamera and turned it into a Film Kamera that is also capable of continuously projecting a string of photos, thus creating moving images.

721141218.text: This technique is still in its preliminary stages and is far from perfect, so I have yet to formally apply for a patent. Not that I really could apply at this point in my current circumstances...

721141219.text: But before I left Fontaine, I heard that some of my colleagues were quite interested in this act of playing back images in sequence... *sigh* I can only hope that they don't act all too quickly...

subQuests.subQuestName: Activate the Kamuijima Cannons and destroy the rifts

721141301.text: Why are the Fatui interested in the Tatarigami?

721141401.text: There should be something about this in the "Mikage Furnace Emergency Response Procedures (Trial Version)" somewhere...

721141402.text: Ah, hello there. I fear I'm not done with the preparations yet. Did you have something you wanted to ask me?

721141404.text: Well, I came to Inazuma with the consultant team. In truth, I'm just your everyday engineer.

721141405.text: To be honest, my real reason for being here was to shoot a "dokumentari film" on-site at the Mikage Furnace for the purpose of promoting our nation's technologies.

721141406.text: But seeing the furnace's current state, I think it's best if I didn't shoot that film...

721141501.text: Please do go to check out our surroundings. I feel that these abnormal readings must surely have something to do with what's happening within the Mikage Furnace.

721141701.text: Is there something I can help you with?

721141702.text: What's all this "Mikage Furnace" and "Tatarigami" talk?

721141703.text: It's just a small problem. We just need a little time to sort it out...

721141704.text: You're an adventurer, aren't you? This place isn't for you or your ilk. Get out of here.

721140503.text: Goodness me, they don't beat about the bush, do they...

721140505.text: Their lack of care for the delicacies of law are really...

721140506.text: Ah. Well. *cough* The further they are from me, the better.

721140508.text: It seems like their target is Tatarigami energy, which is within the Mikage Furnace.

721140509.text: Go check up on the status of the storage device inside the Mikage Furnace while the Fatui are distracted by all this ruckus we're making.

721140510.text: If you encounter any Fatui, why, take them out.

721140511.text: I have every confidence in your abilities.

subQuests.subQuestName: Get close to the Mikage Furnace
Take a picture of the storage device

721142103.text: #{NICKNAME}! I never expected to see you here. What a wonderful surprise!

721142105.text: #To help out, you say? Well... I'm truly grateful for your kindness, and it's nothing short of a blessing to meet a {M#good gentleman}{F#fair lady} like you right here and now.

721142106.text: But, with all due respect, as for the problem I'm facing right now... even though you look quite skilled, I don't believe there is any help you can offer...

721142107.text: After all, we cannot fix the Mikage Furnace with just two very kind hearts...

721142108.text: On the way here, did you happen to see a protective cover that looks like... a bubble?

721142110.text: Oh... Okay then. No, that makes sense, the containment dome's not usually visible — if you want to view it from a distance, you have to employ a specific observation technique...

721142113.text: Not with my eyes, that's for sure. I... "see" it by availing myself of the "Mikage Furnace Emergency Response Procedures (Trial Version)."

721142114.text: I've followed the instructions to the letter. Based on the readings provided by the instrument, it seems that the dome has been successfully activated.

721142115.text: Ah, one other thing I should mention is that, technically speaking, its official name is the Mikage Furnace Emergency Containment Dome.

721142116.text: Now, as for the Mikage Furnace—

721142118.text: Fantastic! She is a considerate and capable young lady. Ah, what a blessing it is to become acquainted with one such as her.

721142119.text: Please give me the short version.

721142120.text: ...Basically, it's a super-smelter built using Fontaine technology, powered by a Tatarigami core brought over from Yashiori Island.

721142121.text: Due to the impact of the war, the Mikage Furnace is now in an extremely unstable state...

721142122.text: But whatever happens, I've now sealed it following the "Mikage Furnace Emergency Response Procedures (Trial Version)," so the problem is almost certainly contained, to some extent...

721142124.text: Well, it might be 893 pages long, but the trial version has no information on the emergency measures applicable in a wartime scenario...

721142125.text: We need to form an editors' group for the "Trial Version: Expanded Edition (1st Issue)" and have a detailed discussion on additional emergency scenarios...

721142126.text: Anyway, point being, even though I have followed the emergency response measures, they aren't the most complete... and the environment within the containment dome has turned... hmm... less than ideal, shall we say.

721142127.text: The Mikage Furnace has now ceased operation indefinitely, and that soldier is getting incredibly antsy about it.

721142128.text: Allegedly, Miyuki recently borrowed some of his people to arrange for the evacuation of the civilians. Now that really got him riled up, hahaha...

721142129.text: But if things continue like they are, who knows. Tatarasuna might just turn into a glorious firework visible all the way from my dear home, the beautiful town of Petrichor...

721140605.text: Yes, and I took a picture of it.

721141801.text: If something were to go wrong with the Tatarigami inside the Mikage Furnace...

721141802.text: Well, if that happens, you should probably leave the island.
